description:
Search PropertyList's full Spanish property MLS by structured filters.
Use for queries that translate cleanly to fields: bedrooms, bathrooms,
price ceiling, property type, area name. For free-form briefs use
find_properties_by_description instead.

Returns a paginated list with summary text plus structured JSON. Every
property carries `oracle_verified` and `oracle_attestation_url` —
true when PropertyList Oracle holds a verified attestation for the listing's municipality and segment.

A `location` we do not hold returns zero results with
error: location_not_found and location_match.matched: false. It
never substitutes listings from other areas. `location_id` takes an
area id from autocomplete_location instead of a name; a group id
(type group, e.g. a region or a coast) searches every area in the
group.

`features` keeps only listings that have ALL the features asked
for: pool (any pool, communal included), private_pool,
communal_pool, sea_view, garden, parking (a garage or parking space)
and terrace. Each
result then carries matched_features, saying which tags (and, for
parking and terrace, which space count or terrace size) the listing
matched on. private_pool means the listing is tagged with a private
or heated pool; many agency feeds tag every pool that way, communal
ones included, so use pool for "with a pool" and check the listing
when a pool must be private. communal_pool means the listing is
tagged with a communal (shared) pool: use it when the user asks for
a communal pool; pool also finds the communal pools a feed tagged
as private, so widen to pool when communal_pool finds too few.

`location.city` is whatever tier the listing was filed under and
may be a municipality OR a locality inside one. To place a listing
administratively use `location.municipality` (with its INE
municipality_code); it is null, never guessed, when we cannot
resolve it.

`location.latitude` / `location.longitude` are present whenever
we hold a real coordinate; the fields are absent otherwise, and
are never 0,0. `location.coordinates_precision` says what the
point is: exact or street is the property itself, approximate is
a pin the agent keeps private, rounded to about 1 km, locality or
administrative_area is an area centroid (accurate to the town,
not the building), unknown is a pin we hold no precision record
for.

features.description: Only listings with ALL of these: pool (any pool), private_pool (tagged private or heated pool), communal_pool (tagged communal pool), sea_view, garden (private, landscaped or communal), parking (garage or parking space), terrace. Results say what each matched on in matched_features.

language.description: Preferred language for property titles and description excerpts.

location.description: Free-text place name (city, suburb, or urbanisation). e.g. 'Marbella', 'Nueva Andalucia', 'Sotogrande'. Pre-resolved with autocomplete_location if you need to confirm match.

location_id.description: Area id from autocomplete_location. Takes precedence over location. A group id (a region or coast, type group) searches every area in the group.

price_max.description: Maximum price in euros (sale) or monthly euros (rent).

price_min.description: Minimum price in euros (sale) or monthly euros (rent).

property_types.description: Comma-separated slugs: apartments, villas, penthouses, plots, townhouses, commercial.

name: search_properties

price.description: Headline price for the listing's transaction type; read with price_period.

price_period.description: total = sale price, per_month = long-term rent, per_week = holiday rent.
